practice.input: See a slightly torn parcel at a post-office counter and hear one complete, natural Korean conversation about making it ready to send.
practice.output: Explain the parcel problem, ask for a practical fix, and confirm the next step in Korean.
practice.dings: One start cue and one end cue around the finished card

card.title: A Torn Parcel Box
card.situation: At a post office, a customer notices a torn corner on a parcel, asks whether it can be sent safely, repairs it, and confirms the next step.
card.description: Explain a parcel problem, fix it, and confirm what happens next.
card.scene: A customer holds a parcel with a torn corner at the post-office counter while a staff member points to packing tape and a scale.
card.learnerInput: The box, torn corner, tape and scale are visible; eight connected turns in polite Korean, with a reason and practical repair.
card.expectedOutput: Describe the damage, respond to the staff member's suggestion, and check what to do after resealing the parcel.

lines.speaker: minjun
lines.ko: 이 소포를 보내려고 하는데, 상자가 조금 찢어졌어요. 그대로 보내도 될까요?
lines.en: I'd like to send this parcel, but the box is a little torn. Is it okay to send it like this?

lines.speaker: soyeon
lines.ko: 안에 물건이 빠질 수도 있어서, 테이프로 한 번 더 붙이시는 게 좋겠어요.
lines.en: Something inside could fall out, so it would be better to seal it again with tape.

lines.speaker: minjun
lines.ko: 아, 그렇겠네요. 여기서 붙일 수 있을까요?
lines.en: Oh, you're right. Could I tape it up here?

lines.speaker: soyeon
lines.ko: 네, 이 테이프 쓰세요. 붙이신 뒤에 저울 위에 올려 주세요.
lines.en: Sure, use this tape. After you seal it, please put it on the scale.

lines.speaker: minjun
lines.ko: 네, 잠깐만요. 받는 분 주소도 다시 확인해야겠네요.
lines.en: Okay, just a moment. I should double-check the recipient's address too.

lines.speaker: soyeon
lines.en: Take your time. Let me know when you're ready.

lines.speaker: minjun
lines.ko: 다 했어요. 이제 무게를 재면 되죠?
lines.en: I'm done. Do we weigh it now?

lines.speaker: soyeon
lines.ko: 네, 상자를 여기 올려 주세요. 요금은 무게를 확인하고 안내해 드릴게요.
lines.en: Yes, please put the box here. I'll check the weight and then tell you the price.

variationPrompt.en: This time the address on your parcel is smudged. Explain the problem to a post-office worker and ask what to do next.
variationPrompt.ko: 이번에는 소포에 적힌 주소가 번졌습니다. 직원에게 문제를 설명하고 다음에 무엇을 해야 할지 물어보세요.
variationPrompt.sampleAnswerHidden: 주소가 조금 번졌는데, 다시 써야 할까요?

card.artworkBrief: Warm, contemporary Korean post office. A male customer and female staff member discuss a small parcel with one visibly torn corner; packing tape and a scale establish the practical problem and next step. No readable text, addresses, logos, or postal branding.

learningNotes.purpose: Explain and resolve a small real-world service problem, not a TOPIK exam item.
learningNotes.targetConstruction: -려고 하는데 / -을 수도 있어서 / -는 게 좋겠어요 / -신 뒤에
meaningfulChunks: 테이프로 한 번 더 붙이시는 게 좋겠어요
learningNotes.retainedCore: Describe the parcel's condition, accept a fix, and confirm the next action.
learningNotes.variationOpportunity: Change the damage from a torn box to a smudged address and request a solution without seeing a model.
learningNotes.independentProductionPrompt: At the counter, explain that the address is smudged and ask whether you should write it again.
